senses.gloss: बुध् [cf. Zd. bud; Gk. πυθ for (ϕυθ) in πυνθάνομαι, πυθέσθαι, Slav. bǔděti, bǔdrǔ; Lith. budė́ti, budrùs; Goth. biudan; Germ. biotan, bieten; Angl.Sax. béodan; Eng. bid.]
2. बुध् mfn. (nom. भुत्) awaking (cf. उषर्बु॑ध्)
intelligent, wise (cf. अ-बुध्).
बुध mfn. awaking (cf. उषर्-बुध)
intelligent, clever, wise, Mn.; MBh. &c.
बुध m. a wise or learned man, sage, ib.
a god, L.
a dog, L.
N. of a descendant of Soma (and hence also called सौम्य, सौमायन, author of RV. x, 1, and father of Purū-ravas; identified with the planet Mercury)
Mercury (regarded as a son of Soma or the moon), PañcavBr.; MBh.; R. &c. of a descendant of Atri and author of RV. v, 1; Anukr.
of a son of Vega-vat and father of Tṛṇa-bindu, Pur.
of various authors, Cat.
बुधा f. Nardostachys Jatamansi, L.
बुधे ind. on a Wednesday (= बुध-वारे), L.
बुध—कौशिक m. N. of an author, Cat.
बुध—गुप्त m. N. of a prince (also written बुद्ध-ग्˚), Buddh.
बुध—चार m. N. of a ch. of Bhaṭṭotpala's Comm. on VarBṛS. and of a ch. of Yavaneśvara's Mīna-rāja-jātaka.
बुध—जन m. a wise man W.
बुध—तात m. B˚'s (or the planet Mercury's) father, the moon, L.
बुध—दर्शन-चार m. N. of ch. of Yavaneśvara's Mīna-rāja-jātaka.
बुध—दिन n. B˚'s (or the planet Mercury's) day, Wednesday, Cat.
बुध—देश m. N. of a place, MW.
बुध—नाडि f. N. of wk.
बुध—पूजा f. N. of wk.
बुध—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
बुध—मनोहर m. n. N. of wk.
बुध—रञ्जिणी f. N. of wk.
बुध—रत्न n. ‘B˚'s gem’, an emerald, L.
बुध—वार m. = -दिन, L.
बुध—शान्ति f. N. of wk.
बुध—सानु m. = पर्न or = यज्ञ-पुरुष, L.
बुध—सुत m. ‘B˚'s son’, N. of Purū-ravas (the first king of the lunar dynasty), Pur.
बुध—सूक्त n. N. of wk.
बुध—स्मृति f. N. of wk.
बुधाष्टमी f. ‘the 8th (day) of B˚’, N. of a festival, Cat.
बुधाष्टमी—व्रत n. N. of wk.
बुधाष्टमी—व्रत-काल-निर्णय m. N. of wk.
बुधक m. N. of a man, Veṇīs.
बु॑धन्-वत् mfn. containing the root बुध्, TBr.
बुधान॑ mfn. awaking, rousing, RV. iv, 51, 8, vii, 68, 9
being heeded (?), ib. iv, 23, 8
knowing, wise, prudent, L.
one who speaks kindly, L.
बुधान॑ m. a sage, spiritual guide, holy teacher, L.
बुधित mfn. known, understood, W.
बुधिल mfn. wise, learned, L.
बुधेय m. pl. N. of a school of the white Yajur-veda, Āryav.
बुध्य mfn. See अ-बुध्य॑.
बुध्न॑ m. n. (probably not connected with √ बुध्; but cf. Uṇ. iii, 5) bottom, ground, base, depth, lowest part of anything (as the root of a tree &c.), RV.; AV.; ŚBr. (बु॑ध्न), ŚrS.; ChUp.
the sky, Nir.
the body, ib.
N. of a son of the 14th Manu, VP.; often w.r. for बुध्न्य
बुध्न [cf. Gk.πυθμήν Lat. fundus; Germ. bodam, bodem, Boden; Angl.Sax. botm; Eng. bottom.]
बुध्न—रोग m. a partic. disease, Car. (cf. ब्रध्न and ब्रध्म).
बुध्न॑—वत् (बुध्न॑-), mfn. having a foot or basis, TS.
बुध्नि॑य mfn. -next, TBr.
बुध्न्य᳙ mfn. being on the ground or at the base, coming from or belonging to the depths, RV. &c. &c. (very often in connexion with अ॑हि, q.v.)
N. of a son of the 14th Manu, VP.
